items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: He was a blues singer. He could sing (inaudible) Johnny Mathis.

ctx.x: Yeah, that would be interesting. I'm going to just -- after the Cavalcade of Jazz, Eddie, is this right, that you lead a small touring band with vocalist (inaudible) Harris and Larry Darnelle. What sort of singer was Larry Darnelle?
He was a blues singer. He could sing (inaudible) Johnny Mathis. (Inaudible.)
And (inaudible) would take care of the rougher blues.
